name: Do I need to select my sink and fixtures before ordering countertops?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to select my sink and fixtures before ordering countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose and purchase your sink and faucet before the countertop templating appointment. Fabricators require the physical sink on-site or its exact manufacturer specification sheet to cut and polish precise openings. Undermount sinks, drop-in basins, and farmhouse apron-front sinks each demand distinct cabinet adjustments and countertop cuts. Securing your sink, faucet, cooktop, and soap dispensers early prevents measurement delays and ensures cutouts match your fixtures exactly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Fabricators need your exact sink, faucet, and cooktop specifications before templating to ensure accurate cutouts and proper fit during installation.
